accounts.name: Checking Account — Mesa Verde Operating
accounts.description: Primary operating checking account. All Toast deposits land here. All vendor ACH payments originate here.

accounts.name: Savings Reserve
accounts.description: Emergency and tax reserve account.

accounts.name: Petty Cash
accounts.description: On-site cash box for small incidental purchases.

accounts.name: Accounts Receivable
accounts.description: Outstanding amounts owed to Mesa Verde — primarily catering deposits and event invoices.

accounts.name: Food Inventory — On Hand
accounts.description: Estimated value of food inventory currently on premises. Updated from theoretical counts.

accounts.name: Liquor & Beverage Inventory — On Hand
accounts.description: Estimated value of liquor, beer, wine, and NA beverages currently on premises.

accounts.name: Prepaid Expenses
accounts.description: Insurance premiums and annual software subscriptions paid in advance.

accounts.name: Kitchen Equipment
accounts.description: Ovens, ranges, fryers, refrigeration units, and other major kitchen equipment.

accounts.name: Accumulated Depreciation — Kitchen Equipment
accounts.description: Contra account for kitchen equipment depreciation.

accounts.name: Furniture & Fixtures
accounts.description: Tables, chairs, bar stools, host stand, and decorative fixtures.

accounts.name: Accumulated Depreciation — Furniture & Fixtures
accounts.description: Contra account for furniture and fixtures depreciation.

accounts.name: Leasehold Improvements
accounts.description: Build-out costs, HVAC upgrades, hood installation, and other tenant improvements.

accounts.name: Accumulated Depreciation — Leasehold Improvements
accounts.description: Contra account for leasehold improvement amortization.

accounts.name: POS & Technology Equipment
accounts.description: Toast terminals, tablets, receipt printers, networking hardware.

accounts.name: Accounts Payable
accounts.description: Amounts owed to vendors. All vendor invoices post here pending owner approval.

accounts.name: Sales Tax Payable
accounts.description: State and local sales tax collected from customers. Remitted monthly.

accounts.name: Tips Payable
accounts.description: Tips collected from card transactions pending distribution to staff.

accounts.name: Gift Cards Liability
accounts.description: Unredeemed gift card balances.

accounts.name: Payroll Liabilities — FICA Employee
accounts.description: Employee-side Social Security and Medicare withheld, pending IRS remittance.

accounts.name: Payroll Liabilities — FICA Employer
accounts.description: Employer-side Social Security and Medicare, pending IRS remittance.

accounts.name: Payroll Liabilities — Federal Income Tax Withheld
accounts.description: Federal income tax withheld from employee paychecks, pending IRS remittance.

accounts.name: Short-Term Loan — Equipment
accounts.description: 12-month equipment financing for hood and ventilation upgrade.

accounts.name: Long-Term Loan — SBA
accounts.description: SBA 7(a) loan used for initial restaurant build-out.

accounts.name: Owner's Equity
accounts.description: Owner capital contributions and retained earnings.

accounts.name: Owner's Draw
accounts.description: Distributions taken by owner. Contra equity account.

accounts.name: Retained Earnings
accounts.description: Cumulative net income retained in the business.

accounts.name: Food Sales
accounts.description: All food revenue from Toast POS. Excludes beverage and alcohol.

accounts.name: Liquor Sales
accounts.description: Spirits, cocktail, and liquor revenue from Toast POS.

accounts.name: Beer & Wine Sales
accounts.description: Beer and wine revenue from Toast POS.

accounts.name: Non-Alcoholic Beverage Sales
accounts.description: Soda, coffee, juice, water, and NA beverage revenue.

accounts.name: Catering & Event Revenue
accounts.description: Private dining, off-site catering, and event buyout revenue.

accounts.name: Comps & Voids — Contra Revenue
accounts.description: Manager comps, void adjustments, and customer refunds. Reduces gross revenue.

accounts.name: Food Cost — Produce
accounts.description: Vegetables, fruits, herbs, and fresh produce purchases. Primary vendor: Sunrise Produce.

accounts.name: Food Cost — Meat & Poultry
accounts.description: Beef, chicken, pork, lamb, and deli meat purchases. Primary vendor: Rio Grande Meats.

accounts.name: Food Cost — Dairy & Eggs
accounts.description: Cheese, butter, cream, eggs, and dairy products. Primary vendor: High Desert Dairy.

accounts.name: Food Cost — Dry Goods & Pantry
accounts.description: Flour, rice, beans, canned goods, oils, spices, and pantry staples.

accounts.name: Food Cost — Seafood
accounts.description: Fresh and frozen seafood purchases.

accounts.name: Liquor Cost
accounts.description: Spirits, mixers, and cocktail ingredient purchases. Primary vendor: Southwest Spirits.

accounts.name: Beer & Wine Cost
accounts.description: Beer kegs, bottles, and wine case purchases.

accounts.name: Labor — FOH Hourly Wages
accounts.description: Front-of-house hourly wages: servers, bussers, hosts, bartenders.

accounts.name: Labor — BOH Hourly Wages
accounts.description: Back-of-house hourly wages: line cooks, prep cooks, dishwashers.

accounts.name: Labor — Management Salaries
accounts.description: General manager and kitchen manager salaried compensation.

accounts.name: Payroll Tax Expense — FICA
accounts.description: Employer share of Social Security (6.2%) and Medicare (1.45%).

accounts.name: Workers Compensation Insurance
accounts.description: Workers comp premium. Allocated monthly.

accounts.name: Rent & Occupancy
accounts.description: Monthly base rent. NNN lease — utilities billed separately.

accounts.name: Utilities — Electric
accounts.description: Monthly electric bill. Ranges $900-$1,400 depending on season.

accounts.name: Utilities — Gas
accounts.description: Monthly natural gas bill for cooking and HVAC.

accounts.name: Utilities — Water & Sewer
accounts.description: Monthly water and sewer charges.

accounts.name: Linen & Uniforms
accounts.description: Weekly linen service (tablecloths, napkins) and staff uniform purchases. Primary vendor: Southwest Linen Co.

accounts.name: Smallwares & Kitchen Supplies
accounts.description: Glassware, plateware, cutlery, cookware, prep containers, and kitchen tools under $500.

accounts.name: Cleaning Supplies
accounts.description: Sanitizer, degreasers, mop supplies, trash liners, and janitorial products.

accounts.name: Paper & To-Go Supplies
accounts.description: To-go containers, paper bags, napkins, straws, and disposable serviceware.

accounts.name: Marketing & Advertising
accounts.description: Social media ads, Google ads, print, and promotional spend.

accounts.name: Third-Party Delivery Commissions
accounts.description: DoorDash and Uber Eats commission fees (typically 15-30% of delivery revenue).

accounts.name: Repairs & Maintenance
accounts.description: Equipment repairs, HVAC service, plumbing, and general facility maintenance.

accounts.name: Insurance — General Liability
accounts.description: General liability and property insurance. Monthly allocation from annual premium.

accounts.name: Insurance — Liquor Liability
accounts.description: Dram shop / liquor liability insurance.

accounts.name: Software & Technology
accounts.description: Toast POS subscription, QuickBooks Online, BookKeep Buddy, reservation system, and other SaaS.

accounts.name: Credit Card Processing Fees
accounts.description: Toast and card processor transaction fees (approx. 2.5% of card revenue).

accounts.name: Professional Services — Accounting
accounts.description: CPA fees for tax preparation and quarterly review.

accounts.name: Licenses & Permits
accounts.description: Business license, health permit, liquor license renewal, food handler certifications.

accounts.name: Depreciation Expense
accounts.description: Monthly depreciation on kitchen equipment, furniture, fixtures, and leasehold improvements.

accounts.name: Interest Expense
accounts.description: Interest on SBA loan and equipment financing.

accounts.name: Miscellaneous Expense
accounts.description: Catch-all for uncategorized or one-off expenses awaiting re-classification.

ACC-4000 through ACC-4030 receive daily Toast revenue postings
